## Checklist
- [ ] `composer check` passes (Pint, PHPStan level 10, Pest, security tests, audit)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] README / docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] New strings added to all four locales
- [ ] Touched `FastRules`? Ran `composer fuzz` and `composer mutate`
